text: The Contractor shall submit the documents listed in the master document register for review. The Engineer shall respond within the review period in ER-17.01 with one of: code 1 (no comments), code 2 (proceed subject to comments), code 3 (revise and resubmit) or code 4 (for information). Work shall not start on items subject to review until code 1 or 2 has been obtained.
title: Contractor's documents and review
